semiconductor_relevance: High — Visino Technology provides specialized equipment for semiconductor manufacturing processes, including inspection, sorting, and placement systems.
summary: Visino Technology (Xiamen) Co., Ltd specializes in the design and manufacture of automation and processing equipment for the semiconductor industry. Their product offerings include wafer optical inspection equipment, die sorters, pick and place systems, and flip chip placement systems. They also provide cleaning and washing equipment for assembly and packaging, as well as mold and precision machinery parts.
